definitions.gloss: easy to drink; palatable; smooth; goes down easily
definitions.explanation: Describes a beverage or liquid medicine that is pleasant or not difficult to consume. Can refer to flavor, texture, or size of a drink that makes it comfortable to swallow.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ワイン→ワイン：01067_wain⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{飲|の}みやすい。
examples.english: This wine is easy to drink.

examples.japanese: {飲|の}みやすい⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}えて→変える：01089_kaeru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had my medicine changed to one that's easier to take.

examples.japanese: ⟦フルーツ→フルーツ：11247_furuutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧がして、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧{飲|の}みやすい⟦ジュース→ジュース：01033_juusu⟧だ。
examples.english: It tastes like fruit and is a very easy-to-drink juice.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{苦味|にがみ}→苦味：14101_nigami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}なく→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧、⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}→初心者：10149_shoshinsha⟧で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{飲|の}みやすい。
examples.english: This beer has little bitterness, so it's easy to drink even for beginners.

notes:
Formed from the verb ⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ (to drink) + やすい (easy to ~). This is a productive grammatical pattern in Japanese: verb stem + やすい creates an adjective meaning "easy to do." Despite being grammatically predictable, {飲|の}みやすい is extremely common as a set phrase in product descriptions, reviews, and everyday conversation about beverages.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飲|の}みやすい⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧: an easy-to-drink flavor
- {飲|の}みやすい⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧: an easy-to-drink size
- {飲|の}みやすい⟦{錠剤|じょうざい}→錠剤：17290_jouzai⟧: easy-to-swallow tablets
- ⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧{飲|の}みやすい: very easy to drink

RELATED PATTERNS:
- ⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧にくい: hard to drink (opposite)
- ⟦{食|た}べやすい→食べやすい：21799_tabeyasui⟧: easy to eat (same pattern with ⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧)
- ⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧やすい: easy to read (same pattern with ⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧)
